assumptions: the recorded UI actions reached the editor and explicit save navigation boundaries
consequence: the edited title is absent immediately after save or after reopening
mechanism: the accepted save path may fail to retain the edited title across subsequent reads
quality_property: edited task persistence across explicit save, reopen, and process boundaries
rationale: Pre-save, post-save, reopened, and post-process checkpoints make the bounded persistence behavior falsifiable without attributing it to an internal repository mechanism.
required_evidence: reopened and post-process layout, screenshot, and log evidence
trigger: create one uniquely named task, edit it, and invoke Save once
